environment.description: Flask application deployed on EKS behind an NGINX Ingress Controller (v1.9.4) with annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client set to 'on' and auth-tls-secret pointing to a namespace-scoped Secret containing the corporate CA bundle (cn=Internal-Services-CA, O=Corp). The ingress resource specifies auth-tls-verify-depth of 2 and auth-tls-pass-certificate-to-upstream-header is enabled. Only clients presenting a valid leaf certificate chaining to Internal-Services-CA can establish a connection. The ingress additionally sets auth-tls-error-page to a 495 status page. No IP allowlisting is configured. The pod itself listens on 8080 with no TLS.

config.pod_exposure: ClusterIP service, no NodePort, no LoadBalancer
